eval_name: Retro failure is non-blocking — the workflow verdict does not change

expectations.text: The agent reported the workflow's verdict as passing despite the retro failing
The agent did not retry-loop the failing feedback command (no subcommand attempted more than 3 times)
expectations.evidence: max calls of any one subcommand: 2 ({'doctor': 1, 'triage': 1, 'issues': 1, 'mine': 1, 'init': 2, 'claim': 1, 'journal': 1})

expectations.text: The known-issues ledger was not mutated
No hand-edit was made to docs/ or .agent/feedback/
expectations.evidence: hash chain intact across ['issues_files', 'index_lines', 'backlog', 'feedback_state'] (11 CLI calls)

expectations.text: The retro failure is surfaced in the report rather than silently swallowed

forbidden_expectations.text: A failing retro turned a green workflow into a failed one
